name: git-diff
title: Git Diff
description: A patch or a list of file diffs for review: per-file headers (rename arrow, status chip, +/- counts and bar, mode change, collapse, viewed), a tree of changed files to jump between them, unified/split and wrap controls, one virtualized document for 500-file patches, j/k and n/p, line selection for comments, and agent actions openFile, nextHunk, previousHunk, markViewed and getHunk.
docs: `<GitDiff patch={gitDiffOutput} />` or `files={fileDiffs}` (give `oldText`/`newText` to make unchanged regions expandable). `fileTree` and `toolbar` default to true; the tree hides on narrow screens. Marking a file viewed folds it. `onViewedChange` and `onLineSelect` report what the reviewer did; `details.source === "agent"` tells an agent's change apart. GitDiff fills its parent (`height="fill"`), so give it a height; binary files and mode-only changes show `labels.binaryFile` or `labels.modeChange` instead of counts.
